semantic.justification: AQF9AG ports the original widened signed32 checked add/multiply with signed32 output stored before overflow comparison. Exact signed64 multiplication uses bigint, preserving low bits beyond binary64 integer precision. Other native platform/time/utility APIs remain unported. Source uprv_getUTCtime now exposes the OS clock boundary through Date.now only. No host Date calendar arithmetic, parsing or host timezone rule data is used. Debug fake-time and native fractional clock precision/ABI remain uncertified. Original ICU78.3 UDataPathIterator now uses actual CharString fields, borrowed byte pointers and original item-directory precedence, separator/empty-segment iteration, explicit four-byte file matching, package-stub truncation, dat skipping and long suffix joining. putil now owns original data/timezone directory once records, copied NUL storage, status overloads, getter/setter order and represented directory cleanup. Browser processes have no OS environment namespace or installed native archive directory; the original absent-input branches apply, without changing UDATA_DEFAULT_ACCESS or selecting MAP_NONE. 752 sequences/5524 complete initialized snapshots match unchanged udata.cpp/putil.cpp methods and actual statics; native source is compiled without installation-directory defines and the two environment variables are absent in the child. Private visibility only exposes fields for observation; no method, mapper, allocator or provider is substituted. Native allocation failure/free/thread/physical ABI, uninitialized spans, invalidated borrows and unported OS locale/TZ-search cleanup fields are not certified. Actual udata_open/path-to-mapper/common-data orchestration, production package/iterator/engine/service installation, NatNum12 output, multiline EditEngine import and final CSV acceptance remain pending.
